description: One voltage turned into eight gates, in 4HP, with a polyphonic output that can carry more bits than eight

params.text: Sets how wide a span the input is read across, 0V to 10V
Attenuates and inverts the range CV between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%
Sets where the span falls, -10V to +10V, read as its bottom, middle or top according to the button beside it
Attenuates and inverts the anchor CV between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%
Steps the anchor knob's meaning through minimum, centre and maximum, with a light showing which

inputs.text: The voltage being converted; it is clamped to the span before the conversion
Adds its voltage to the span after the trim knob
Adds its voltage to the anchor after the trim knob

outputs.text: Carries that bit of the converted value as a gate, 10V for a 1 and 0V for a 0
Carries the converted value as one channel per bit, at whatever depth the menu sets, 8 unless you change it

notes: the eight separate jacks always convert to eight bits; only the polyphonic jack follows the menu's bit depth, and a red mark beside it shows when that is not 8
bit 1 changes fastest and bit 8 slowest, so feeding a saw in turns the jacks into a run of clock divisions, each half the rate of the one below
menu: Polyphonic bits-in-use: 2 up to 16, 8 (default) — sets how many bits the polyphonic output is converted to
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it

inputs.0:
one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
